project_type: Laravel 11 PHP monolith with Livewire, Blade templates, Alpine.js frontend
build_system: Composer for PHP deps; npm/vite for frontend assets. No compile step required for PHP changes. Run `npm run build` only if Vite assets are changed (none are in this task).
test_framework: No automated test suite found (no tests/ directory with runnable tests). Verification is manual: `php artisan migrate`, `php artisan route:list`, `php artisan tinker`, browser testing.
build_command: php artisan config:clear && php artisan route:clear && php artisan view:clear
test_command: php artisan migrate --pretend && php artisan route:list && php artisan schedule:list
verification_instructions: 1. Run `php artisan migrate` to apply new migrations. 2. Run `php artisan route:list | grep -E 'attendance|feedback'` to confirm new routes exist. 3. Run `php artisan schedule:list` to confirm both commands are scheduled. 4. Run `php artisan sessions:complete-expired` to confirm command runs without fatal errors. 5. Manually visit `/bookings/{uuid}` for confirmed booking and verify room panel shows '5 minutes before' copy.
environment_constraints: Windows Server host. Shell is PowerShell. Use `php artisan` not `./artisan`. Database is MySQL on 127.0.0.1. Queue driver is 'database' (no Redis). Mail is SMTP. APP_ENV=production but APP_DEBUG=false — check logs at storage/logs/laravel.log.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. No CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow existing code style: 4-space indent in PHP, PSR-4 namespacing under App\, use DB::transaction for multi-row writes, use Log::warning for non-fatal errors. Blade uses inline CSS (no Tailwind utility classes in the bookings show/meeting-room views).
key_patterns: 1. Controllers use route-model binding by UUID (`getRouteKeyName = uuid`). 2. Notifications send via `Notification::sendNow()` (synchronous, bypasses queue). 3. Wallet credits use `Wallet::firstOrCreate(['user_id'=>...], ['balance'=>0,'currency'=>'KES'])` then `$wallet->credit(amount, description, reference)`. 4. All booking email views use inline CSS table layout matching `resources/views/emails/booking-confirmed-student.blade.php`. 5. `routes/console.php` uses `Schedule` facade for Laravel 11 scheduling. 6. Migrations use `if (!Schema::hasColumn(...))` guards.
directory_structure: app/Http/Controllers/ — all web controllers; app/Models/ — Eloquent models; app/Services/ — service layer (BookingService, JitsiService, RefundService, EarningsService, DarajaService); app/Console/Commands/ — artisan commands; app/Notifications/ — Laravel notification classes; resources/views/pages/bookings/ — booking Blade views (show.blade.php, meeting-room.blade.php); resources/views/emails/ — email templates; database/migrations/ — all migrations; routes/web.php — web routes; routes/console.php — scheduled commands; .agents/tasks/ — planning artifacts (this directory)
